curationNotes: Curated from live indexed Wix small-business sites found in the 2026-05-13 2:00 AM run. Search review stayed under the 25-site cap; selected 10 high-fit local-service opportunities with direct contact info and visible conversion cleanup needs. Prototypes must be GPT-5.5-authored one site per isolated sub-agent, no generic generator.

items.name: Intellipaint LLC
items.summary: Licensed/insured painter with real services and contact flow, but the homepage has long generic copy, repeated service blocks, and a weak quote path.
items.angle: Keep the painter/craftsmanship feel and real project imagery while tightening service hierarchy, quote CTA, trust cues, and contact form expectations.

items.name: JR Contracting & Handyman Services LLC
items.summary: Simple Wix contractor site has clear contact info and service categories, but it reads generic and does not convert from the first screen.
items.angle: Preserve the compact contractor layout while sharpening the hero, service explanations, proof, and a faster quote/contact route.

items.name: Portillo Home Improvement LLC
items.summary: The site has real geography, email, and project-photo energy, but the page is sparse and relies on a broad mission statement instead of a conversion path.
items.angle: Keep the minimal photo-forward presentation while adding clearer project types, estimate CTA, trust/service-area cues, and a more useful contact section.

items.name: Ranger Landscaping LLC
items.summary: Landscaper has a strong local story, owner mention, services, and estimate intent, but the page can better prioritize seasonal requests and trust proof.
items.angle: Retain the friendly green landscaping style while clarifying residential/commercial services, estimate steps, service area, and owner-led credibility.

items.name: T the Lawn Care, LLC
items.summary: The site has real local service positioning and a free quote CTA, but the above-fold hierarchy and service proof are thin.
items.angle: Keep the full-service lawn-care feel while making the free quote path, services, service area, and latest-work proof more obvious.

items.name: Capps Lawn and Landscaping LLC
items.summary: Local lawn/landscaping site has a clear owner-local angle, services, testimonial, and contact form, but it needs stronger quote framing and service detail.
items.angle: Preserve the simple grass/garden aesthetic while improving hero clarity, service cards, testimonial placement, and contact conversion.

items.name: VSM Plumbing LLC
items.summary: Plumbing site lists useful services and 24/7 phone support, but the hero and testimonial areas still show generic Wix-style filler.
items.angle: Keep the dependable-plumber layout while replacing generic/filler trust elements with emergency/service paths, family-business proof, and one clear call flow.

items.name: Pro Garden Landscaping LLC
items.vertical: landscaping, lawn care, hardscape, and drainage
items.summary: Strong service list and free-estimate language, but the page can organize high-value landscaping work and guide prospects to request details faster.
items.angle: Keep the professional green landscaping page while grouping services by buyer need, reinforcing local trust, and tightening the estimate form section.

items.name: Mint Cleaning Services LLC
items.summary: Cleaning site has strong differentiators, Spanish-friendly note, veteran-owned positioning, reviews, and a quote form, but needs a cleaner conversion hierarchy.
items.angle: Preserve the friendly cleaning-service look while bringing reviews, bilingual/veteran trust, services, and quote CTA into a tighter first-page flow.

items.name: Hager lawncare & landscaping LLC
items.vertical: lawn care, landscaping, tree trimming, and seasonal services
items.summary: Local lawn-care business has service area, phone, and seasonal services, but the site is sparse and can better sell residential/commercial maintenance requests.
items.angle: Keep the small-town lawn-care feel while clarifying the core services, free-estimate CTA, service area, and simple next steps.
